07 — For Tournament Admins

Create a Tournament

The same engine the federation uses. Eight configuration stages, condensed into five steps — publish straight to the discovery grid, then run brackets, referees and disputes from this seat.

Identity & game

Choose an organization you manage, or leave this as a personal event.

Format & competitive rules

Both teams confirm the same score. An assigned referee or authorized bracket staff member reviews it.

This records the event requirement. TUNESF does not provide anti-cheat detection.

Schedule & roster rules

A team roster is snapshotted and locked when its captain registers it.

Prize pool & schedule

1ST · 70%2ND · 30%

Review & publish

The tournament and its prize schedule are saved to TUNESF. Registration opens after the database accepts the event. Prize awards are recorded by placement; this site does not collect or transfer payments.
